```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

pipeline_candidates <- c(
  "../szablony_analiz/anova_rm/3gr_4pomiary/lmm_pipeline_2025_11.R",
  "szablony_analiz/anova_rm/3gr_4pomiary/lmm_pipeline_2025_11.R"
)

pipeline_path <- pipeline_candidates[file.exists(pipeline_candidates)][[1]]
source(pipeline_path)

data_path <- resolve_existing_path_2025_11(params$data_path)
output_dir <- params$output_dir
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Dane i zmienne

```{r}
df_lmm <- load_2025_11_data(data_path, sheet = params$sheet)
variables_to_analyze <- get_batch_variables_2025_11(df_lmm)

cat("Plik danych:", data_path, "\n")
cat("Liczba wierszy:", nrow(df_lmm), "\n")
cat("Liczba uczestnikow:", dplyr::n_distinct(df_lmm$id_osoby), "\n")
cat("Liczba zmiennych do analizy:", length(variables_to_analyze), "\n")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(variable = variables_to_analyze))
```

## Audyt transformacji

```{r}
transform_audit <- build_transform_audit_2025_11(df_lmm, variables_to_analyze)
knitr::kable(transform_audit, digits = 4)
```

## Uruchomienie modeli LMM

```{r}
batch <- run_lmm_batch_2025_11(
  data_path = data_path,
  variables = variables_to_analyze,
  sheet = params$sheet,
  output_dir = output_dir,
  write_workbook = TRUE
)

cat("Zapisano skoroszyt:", batch$workbook_file, "\n")
```

## Podsumowanie omnibus

```{r}
summary_display <- batch$tables$summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_group_fmt = vapply(.data$p_group, fmt_p_2025_11, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    p_time_fmt = vapply(.data$p_time, fmt_p_2025_11, FUN.VALUE = character(1)),
    p_interaction_fmt = vapply(.data$p_interaction, fmt_p_2025_11, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$variable,
    .data$label,
    .data$scale,
    .data$n_obs,
    .data$n_people,
    .data$p_group_fmt,
    .data$p_time_fmt,
    .data$p_interaction_fmt,
    .data$singular,
    .data$status,
    .data$error
  )

knitr::kable(summary_display)
```

## Bledy i ostrzezenia

```{r}
errors <- batch$tables$summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$status != "success" | !is.na(.data$error) | nzchar(.data$warnings))

if (nrow(errors) == 0) {
  cat("Brak bledow i ostrzezen wymagajacych uwagi.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(errors)
}
```

## Render raportow jednostkowych

```{r}
if (isTRUE(params$render_reports)) {
  report_template <- resolve_existing_path_2025_11(
    "szablony_analiz/anova_rm/3gr_4pomiary/raport_lmm_2025_11.Rmd"
  )

  render_results <- lapply(variables_to_analyze, function(var) {
    output_file <- paste0("raport_lmm_", var, ".html")

    tryCatch({
      rmarkdown::render(
        input = report_template,
        output_file = output_file,
        output_dir = output_dir,
        params = list(
          variable = var,
          data_path = data_path,
          sheet = params$sheet
        ),
        envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()),
        quiet = TRUE
      )

      tibble::tibble(variable = var, status = "success", file = file.path(output_dir, output_file), error = NA_character_)
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(variable = var, status = "error", file = NA_character_, error = conditionMessage(e))
    })
  })

  render_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(render_results)
  knitr::kable(render_results)
} else {
  cat("Render raportow jednostkowych pominiety. Ustaw params$render_reports = TRUE, aby wygenerowac HTML dla kazdej zmiennej.")
}
```

cat("Katalog wynikow:", normalizePath(output_dir, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat("Skoroszyt Excel:", batch$workbook_file, "\n")
